LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_TopWarning: Changing these options will require restarting the game to apply. Some options may not apply or will cause errors unless starting a new game.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_BottomWarning: Don't see the options you chose? Restart your game!
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_Label1: These options modify the Horax faction and raids:
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_HoraxShowOnMapDes: Spawns Horaxian cults on the map, allowing you to see them like any other faction. Useful if you want to take the fight to them!\n\nDo not apply mid-game.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_HoraxWillDoRaidsD: Allows for Horaxian raids, instead of just ritual sieges and hate chants. Allows you to see them a bit more often.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_HoraxOnlyBioferri: Causes the hellcat rife, plus the weapons added by VWE: Bioferrite, to only spawn naturally in Horaxian raids.\n\nThis does not include Incinerators, as its primary purpose is destroying Horaxian creations.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_HoraxUseGhoulsDes: Allows a small number of ghouls to spawn with Horaxian raids and rituals.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_HoraxBloodfeeders: High-tier Horaxian Units will sometimes spawn as sanguophages, and their leader will always be a sanguophage. Compatible with VRE: Sanguophages.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_Label2: These options modify psychic ritual sieges:
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_RitualTypesDesc:
Determines the available rituals.

All: They will use the vanilla Skip Abduction and Summon Fleshbeasts rituals, plus the new Summon Shamblers ritual.

No Shamblers: They will only use the vanilla rituals.

No Fleshbeasts: The vanilla Summon Fleshbeasts ritual will be replaced with the new Summon Shamblers ritual.

Abduction Only: They will only use the Skip Abduction ritual.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_RitualFleeStatesD:
Determines if Horaxians leave after completing rituals.

Never: They attack immediately. This is the Vanilla behavior.

Always: They will leave immediately, grabbing any downed pawns along the way.

Abduction Only: They will leave after performing the Skip Abduction ritual, taking any abducted pawns with them.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_Label3: These options modify the cultists ability to set up off-map ritual sites:
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_DoRitualsDesc: Cultists will occasionally create sites near your colony, conducting elaborate rituals that must be dealt with by sending a caravan to kill its invoker.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_AllowSunFractureD: Allows the cultists to conduct a ritual where they blot out the sun!\n\nSimilar to an eclipse or sunblocker event.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_AllowMindFracture: Allows the cultists to conduct a ritual where they drive everyone else to the brink of madness!\n\nSimilar to a psychic drone or the hate chant event.
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_AllowGrayPallDesc: Allows the cultists to conduct a ritual that puts the landscape into a constant gray pall!
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_AllowDeathPallDes: Allows the cultists to conduct a ritual that puts the landscape into a constant death pall!
LanguageData.Oblivion_SlavesOfHorax_AllowBlindFogDesc: Allows the cultists to conduct a ritual that puts the landscape into a constant fog! Twisted silhouettes can be seen within.\n\nBlind Fog requires Odyssey; not having that DLC will make it a regular fog instead, though the other functionality will still work.
